FIELD INCIDENT REPORT
Form FIR-1 (rev. 2026-03)
OPERATOR
Larchwood Liquids Pipeline Inc.
REPORTED BY
Area supervisor
RECEIVED VIA
Text messages
DESCRIPTION OF THE EVENT (what happened, when, where, who, what was released)
Got a call this am from the Williamstown station. Relief valve on line 2A let go around 0845.
Gasoline sprayed past the valve stack, hit the RoW gravel and ran downslope into the
neighbour's corn. I walked the line by 0915-see the pool on the east edge of the RoW, about 10
m into the crop.
Station crew already had the block valve shut. Relief still lifting, threads on the dummy cap look
stripped. Not sure if the diaphragm failed or if someone bumped the set point. Will get the valve
tech out this pm.
SUPERVISOR REVIEW
